name: Spontaneous Learner
body:
You learn new spells more quickly than others.

Prerequisite: Arcane caster level 4th, ability to cast spells spontaneously.

Benefit: Every level, you can choose to learn a new spell in place of one you already know.

Normal: You can choose to learn a new spell every second level (sorcerers) or every third level (bards).
